CustomField.description: Colour-coded aging signal so the days-in-stage health shows on native Kanban cards and list views. Thresholds: over 14 days Overdue, over 7 days Aging.
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Closed Lost")), "🟢 Signed", IF(ISBLANK(Stage_Start_Date__c), "🟢 On track", IF((TODAY() - Stage_Start_Date__c) > 14, "🔴 Overdue", IF((TODAY() - Stage_Start_Date__c) > 7, "🟡 Aging", "🟢 On track"))))
CustomField.label: Aging
